metadata.name: ValidateUserIDPasswordParameters
metadata.description: This API is only used to Validate either UserID or Password Validation Parameters, It will not Reset.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of account holder Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: DecisionFlag
request_fields.description: Flag for confirming if Used for Forget Password or Forget UserID Valid Values:'1' = Forgot Password, '2' = ForgotUserID Format:X Example:2

request_fields.name: AddressLine1
request_fields.description: Card holder's Address Line  1 Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Condition:Address Line 1 of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as option in one of the Validation Field in 'Forgert User ID Validation' or 'Forget Password Validation Parameters in System Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: AddressLine2
request_fields.description: Card holder's Address Line 2 Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Condition:Address Line 2 of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as option in one of the Validation Field in 'Forgert User ID Validation' or 'Forget Password Validation Parameters in System Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: EmailID
request_fields.description: Card holder's Email ID Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z Format: [email protected] Example: [email protected] Condition:EmailID of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as option in one of the Validation Field in 'Forgert User ID Validation' or 'Forget Password Validation Parameters in System and is Set as 'Mandatory' in System Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: HomePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Card holder Home Phone number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7895463214 Condition:Home Phone number of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as option in one of the Validation Field in 'Forgert User ID Validation' or 'Forget Password Validation Parameters in System. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: WorkPhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Card holder Work phone number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXX Example:5678909876 Condition:Work Phone number of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as option in one of the Validation Field in 'Forgert User ID Validation' or 'Forget Password Validation Parameters in System Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: Postal code of the card holder's address. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:46206 Condition:Postal Code of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as option in one of the Validation Field in 'Forgert User ID Validation' or 'Forget Password Validation Parameters in System Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: DateofBirth
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Date of Birth Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/dd/yyyy Example: 02/01/2020 Condition:Date of Birth of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as option in one of the Validation Field in 'Forgert User ID Validation' or 'Forget Password Validation Parameters in System

request_fields.name: SocialSecurityNumber
request_fields.description: Social Security Number of the AccountHolder Format:AAAGGSSSS Example::078051120 Condition:SocialSecurityNumber of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as option in one of the Validation Field in 'Forgert User ID Validation' or "Forget Password Validation Parameters in System Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: CardExpirationDate
request_fields.description: ate when card is be expired. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MMYYYY Example: 012020 Condition:Card Expiration Date of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as option in one of the Validation Field in 'Forgert User ID Validation' or 'Forget Password Validation Parameters' in system Allowable Values: 6

request_fields.name: SSNLast4Digits
request_fields.description: Card holder's last four digit of SSN Valid Values:1120 Format:XXXX Example:1120 Condition:Last 4 digits of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as option in one of the Validation Field in 'Forgert User ID Validation' or'Forget Password Validation Parameters' in system Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: YearofBirth
request_fields.description: Year of Birth of the Account holder Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:1920 Condition:BirthYear of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as option in one of the Validation Field in 'Forgert User ID Validation' or 'Forget Password Validation Parameters' in system

request_fields.name: ListSecurityQuestionsAnswers
request_fields.description: ListSecurityQuestionsAnswers

request_fields.name: CurrentPassword
request_fields.description: Current Password Set for the Account Holder's Selfservice Login Condition:Current Selfservice Password of the Account Holder, Mandatoy if Set as option in one of the Validation Field in 'Forgert User ID Validation' Parameters in System Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: SecurityQuestionID
request_fields.description: ID of the Security Questions set Need to Input exactly as what recived via GetUserRegistrationRequestParamters API Valid Values: 0-9 Format:X Example:1234 Condition:Mandatory if ListSecurityQuestionsAnswer is Mandatory

request_fields.name: SecurityAnswer
request_fields.description: Answer of Security Question set for password protection. Valid Values:a-z,0-9 Format:XXXX Example: John Condition:Mandatory if ListSecurityQuestionsAnswer is Mandatory Allowable Values: 100

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: DecisionFlag
children.description: Will Return The codes for Either UserID or Password Valid Values: '1' = For Password,  '2' = For UserID If Returned for Password, will mean will Prompt on Panel to change the Password If Returned for User ID, will mean the User will be Sent on Account Holders Email or SMS depending on what is Set on Product, or will be Displayed on the Panel Condition: For this API this Tag can be used as one of the Input Paramter for Fecthing the Details
